items.text: Match cockpit crew name with GENDEC during boarding (LX Flight)
Check gate stationery (Ingenico/GD/Lead Phone/iPad/Mandatory Forms / DG Board etc.)
CISF to be at gate before crew
Display Upgrade Signage (if available)
FIDS Gate Open Display as soon as first staff reaches
Gate Setup: Boarding Group Signage, DGR, Passenger Rights, COB Flyer, Standees, Hand Baggage Sizer
Printer Check
Announcement: Boarding Procedure / Level 4 / Travel Docs / Delay if any
Ineligible List to be Cleared (Travel Doc / Level 4 / Payment if any)
High Priority Comments
Web/Mob/ACI PAX to be Checked and Cancelled if Not Reported
Airport Upsell Announcements 15 Minutes Before Flight Commit
Kiosk Bagg Activation
Flight Commit (LX/LH D-60) & Inform Departure to Print Clearance Paper Immediately
Verify if Manifest Submitted and GD Signed
NRP - Needs Printing
Bagg Count & Always Inform LHG DM (Short or Excess Bags)
Send ETD at D-05 From Planned ETD for Delays Greater Than 10 Minutes
In Case of Gate Change, Allocate 1 Staff at Old Gate and Make Announcement
Reconfirm Final PAX Count With RF (Especially for LX)
Check Baggage Waiver Reason (Should Not Be 'Others')
Check RED Bags on BRS After Closing
If Aircraft Not Ready for Crew, Coordinate With Purser and Inform Lead / SPV / ADM / LHDM
REMARKS / IRREGULARITIES OBSERVED
No major delays or irregularities observed. All pre-boarding stationery verified, CISF present at 12:30. Cockpit crew GENDEC verified. Flight commit requested at D-60 as per LHG procedure.
Ensure you are released from check-in counters on time (A-20) to be positioned at the designated gate or ramp.
Verify cleaning, security, and catering staff are present on-site; immediately contact the Ramp SPOC if anyone is missing.
For SWISS flights, verify only the designated trained cleaning supervisor is on-duty and report deviations.
Contact the wheelchair (UH) team to confirm they are at the gate on time with the required wheelchairs.
Ensure aircraft doors and gate doors open on time; remember only arrival crew may open aircraft doors.
T Meet the Purser at door opening, take handover of DEPU/DEPA or INAD, and hand over to the assigned colleague.
Inform the arrival crew to keep CLP/CBD ready and tell them to proceed to arrivals for Immigration
For LX flights, ensure staff access is via 1L only; ramp jackets are mandatory if entering from 2L.
Introduce yourself to the MC/Purser & act as the sole designated point of contact with the aircraft crew for boarding clearance.
Monitor and ensure the timely retraction of Ground Power Units and Air Conditioning Units after use. (D-20)
Coordinate with the Gate Controller (GC) for baby stroller (STRL) counts and timely ramp dispatch of gate bags.
Strictly follow the turnaround grid and immediately post delays in the group to inform the DM, ADM, and Leads.
Follow the strict door closure sequence: U1L must always be closed first, followed by M2L.
Coordinate with the gate Lead to ensure U1 and M2 doors close timely, latest 17 minutes after boarding start.
Keep DIAL Information Lost and Found contact details handy to assist passengers with Level 4 baggage issues.
Secure any left-behind crew items (iPads, phones) in the office, notify LHG DM, and update the group.
Fully complete the ARC sheet, ensuring both SW and Captain signatures and others are physically signed on the document.
Get the Security File checked and verified by the dedicated Ramp staff assigned to the flight before filing.
Complete the RF details sheet in phone in the correct time format and share on WhatsApp by D+20.
For SWISS flights, ensure the trained cleaning supervisor's name is entered in the SI remarks section of the RF sheet.
Securely file all completed flight documentation and security lists in the office cabinets.
Prepare the final RFP Report and hand it over directly to the Duty Manager (DM) to wrap up.
Ensure counters are opened on time after briefing.

Ensure all allocated staff have reported on time and are positioned 
as per DUTY FLOW.
Verify DG Display, Upgrade Display, FIDS and all at every counter.

Coordinate with AOCC to ensure FIDS is updated. For delayed flights, 
immediately inform AOCC to update the flight status in the system.

Ensure UH manpower is available and positioned in front 
of the check-in counters.

Ensure queue-combing staff are positioned at queue lines, exit rows, 
F-Class/C-Class counters.

Promote use of iPads and PSA/ACA applications for sales.
Ensure staff use ACA App for kiosk/SBD support.

Rev X staff available with iPads.
Help achieve station revenue targets.
Drive ancillary sales: Upgrades, Preferred seats, Sleeper's Row, SSAS / SSAB,
Excess baggage
Lobby staff available to divert passengers to SBD/Self Kiosk Check-In.

Review flight details and special passenger requirements. 
Check for AVIH, PETC, special handling cases, wheelchair requests, 
UMNR, etc. Ensure concerned departments are informed 
and required staff are briefed.
Flight scanning should be done properly including all the aspects like ETIX, Seat Issues and Monitor delays, oversales, version changes, and operational disruptions.

Maintain a "bird's eye view" of the entire operation rather than performing frontline tasks yourself.
. Maintain overall operational oversight instead of focusing on individual tasks.
Track scanner and device movement through Inventory App.
Maintain inventory accountability.
Ensure all touchpoints (Check-in, SBD, Gates, Transfers, Arrivals) are being monitored

Monitor handling of:HON/FCL passengers,WCHR passengers, Pregnant passengers,Cast passengers, MAAS passengers
Ensure special passenger requirements are identified early.

Ensure strict SOP compliance with no unauthorized deviations.
Monitor completion of operational checklists.

Ensure the Gate Controller is released at A-40 with one designated 
staff member. The Ramp Floater must be released by A-20. 
Ensure check-in counters are closed at D-90, and the flight is 
closed in the system within the required timeline.

For LX flights (e.g., LX147 / LX2647), ensure flight-specific closing 
announcements are made 20-30 minutes before counter closure. 
Display appropriate signage to inform passengers.
GD for Crew – 7 copies/ +01 which needs to provided at Gate 08 before 22:00Hrs
Collect arrival CLP AND CBD copy from LHG OFFICE
Get Blank Telex papers beforehand
Collect RR List from Early Counter Agent and secure it with yourself.
CREW CLEARANCE
Coordinate with hyatt or Pernam in case of crew coach or cab delays.
Ensure that when crew arrives, meet with purser/MC and take the CLP and CBD and also check it is filled and stamped
Make sure when crew reached T3, they cleared the immigration and security with in 20 minutes.
When crew crossed the security, immidiately inform Gate controller (GC).
D-90 — SYSTEM & DOCUMENT PREPARATION
Print standby list, acceptance list with passport along with GD's and DT slips
D-80 -  SYSTEM & DOCUMENT PREPARATION REACH THE IMMIGRATION COUNTERS FOR FLIGHT CLEARANCE
Calculate the total acceptance, including passenger count, crew count and DT, where applicable.
Deduct the applicable DT from the total acceptance
Inform your final count to the immigration officer, If count is not match with immigration then start tally
D-60 - FLIGHT COMMIT
Check with the Gate Controller or verify in the system regarding the flight commit.
Print all the documents for i.e. Acceptance List with Passport No., no show list, web checkin list. And also print acceptance list without passport for customs
Present the required documents to Immigration.
Cross-check final count
Obtain Immigration clearance/stamp/signature
D-40 MINUTES — CUSTOMS CLEARANCE
Proceed to Customs after Immigration clearance
Submit RR papers, No-Show List, Acceptance List & Cargo Manifest
Obtain Customs clearance
Verify required stamps/signatures
Inform Gate Controller about clearance
Check and record EGM number
Deposit stamped GD and Customs documents
Collect the RR list from the early counters agents and Crew GD'S from Pre-Flight agents.
D-90 : Get the system and make it ready for Printing the documents for flight clearance(chklist to be followed for same).

D-60 : check with Gate Controller or in system about the flight commit(you can chk the noshow list in the system if has the red cross all together it means the flight is closed and also if we have any SBY Passengers in overbooking situations then you can also chk if SBY passengers are accepted in system). If Count not tallied inform the Lead or Gate controller and start the tally.

D-50 : Reach the Immigrations counters for the clearance and check for the count match calculating the total acceptance, crew and DT(you need to minus the DT from the total count of acceptance and crew).
D-40 : After taking Clearance from immigration take the stamp and reach the customs and take the clearance of RR and no show from them and get the stamp and signatures from customs accordingly.
D-30 : Inform the gate about the clearance and take the EGM number from system(deposit the stamped GD along with all the papers you took to customs for clearance).
